items.name: native-theme
items.title: Native operator theme
items.description: Station signal colors for light and dark appearance and glove-sized targets and text, in Uniwind's theme format. Import it from the app's global.css after tailwindcss and uniwind.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold button
items.description: Full-width glove-sized button that confirms after a hold, with a fill bar; lifting or sliding off aborts. Exports useHold for custom controls.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status pill
items.description: A station signal (ok, pending, attention, fault, idle) as icon plus word.

items.name: list-row
items.title: List row
items.description: A glove-sized pressable list row with a wrapping title, a detail line and a trailing slot.
